title: 해양경비법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00432:20200828:00006:part:1/1

Article (Regulations for the Promotion of Aquaculture Industry) No. 432, August 28, 2020

Article 1 (Effective Date) This regulation shall take effect from August 28, 2020. <Note: Omitted>

Articles 2 through 6 are omitted.

Article 7 (Amendments to Other Regulations) Items ① through⑮ are omitted.

<16> The following amendments are made to the "Regulations for the Enforcement of the Maritime Patrol Law":

Article 3, paragraph 1 is amended to include the following item 5:

    5. Aquaculture licenses under Article 10 of the "Act on the Promotion of Aquaculture" (excluding aquaculture licenses under Article 1, paragraph 7, as defined in the same article)

Article 8 is omitted.
